messages:
Maya (marketing): Hey @eng-runtime — last-minute ask for tomorrow's launch post + webinar: we need a verified bench artifact bundle that is auditable. Deliverables: per-request CSVs, aggregated KPI table, cold vs warm profiles, runbook (one paragraph + exact command) and a small slide-ready CSV. Can you take a quick pass?

bench-bot: queued job #99901 - ingesting payloads from drive:/marketing/launch/urgent_payloads.jsonl

Ethan (eng-runtime): We can run this. Quick clarifiers: which model variants? what exact demo thresholds should we flag?

Maya (marketing): Include fp16 and int8-fastkernel. Demo thresholds: median gen <= 260ms for <=64 tokens, embedding p50 <= 32ms. Mark FAIL explicitly. Also include a 10% randomized holdout and record the RNG seed. No cherry-picking.

Priya (eng-runtime): Got it. We'll run batch=1 for the slide numbers. Warm runs = 6 synthetic warmups; cold = strict cold. We will capture per-shard breakdowns and also log kernel versions. ETA: upload artifacts.zip in ~4 hours.

SRE-bot: governance note: manifest must include holdout indices and RNG seed. SRE will validate before any public claim.

Maya (marketing): Thanks — we'll wait for SRE signoff before publishing. Can you also surface any high-variance cases so we can decide to call them out in the notes?

Ethan (eng-runtime): Will do. If p95/p50 ratio > 3 for gen we'll run a labeled rerun with longer warmup and keep both artifacts. We'll include a short variance decomp in the README.

bench-bot: job #99901 -> ingest complete: 30 payloads detected, artifacts staged at /artifacts/99901

Priya (eng-runtime): Smoke started. Posting a tiny sample of the runs CSV for visibility: 

```
req_id,variant,warmup,total_ms,model_ms,tokens
s1,fp16,false,410,395,48
s2,int8,true,198,184,32
s3,fp16,false,1320,1305,1400
```

Priya (eng-runtime): Initial p50/p95 for short prompts looks ok, but p95 skewed by a few long-context outliers. We'll mark those in the per-request CSV and run the rerun if needed.

Ethan (eng-runtime): Example public run command we'll put in the runbook (edited for docs):

```bash
benchctl run --model redwood-7b-v2 --variant int8 --batch 1 --warmup 6 --payloads payloads.jsonl --out runs/warm_int8.csv
```

Maya (marketing): Perfect. When you upload artifacts.zip, please paste a one-line checklist in this thread: artifacts present, manifest with RNG seed and holdout indices, slide-ready summary, runbook included. We'll then coordinate SRE validation and finalize slide copy.

Priya (eng-runtime): Uploading now. Note in README: int8 used fast-kernel v4, KV-cache enabled for warm runs. Also attached a short variance.txt explaining which requests caused p95 spikes.

bench-bot: job #99901 -> runs complete, artifacts uploaded at drive:/artifacts/99901/artifacts.zip

Priya (eng-runtime): Checklist: artifacts present, manifest.txt (seed=4839201, holdout=indices listed), slide_summary.csv included, runbook.md included.

SRE-bot: Received manifest. Running validation of holdout selection and per-request logs. ETA 30min.

Ethan (eng-runtime): If SRE asks for rerun, we'll keep original artifacts and append rerun labeled with rerun_timestamp.

Maya (marketing): Thanks everyone — will wait for SRE signoff before updating the blog/webinar slides. :thumbsup:
